notes: Ask for the quiet parts to come up the way you'd actually say it. "Raise the quiet parts", "level the speech", "bring up the quiet bits" and "make just the quiet parts louder" all reach the levelling tool now — before, most of them reached nothing, and a couple quietly applied a flat volume boost that lifted the loud parts just as much. Levelled audio no longer pins at full scale. "Slow it down to a third" slows to a third instead of a half. And if you ask to change only part of a clip, Crisp now says it works on the whole clip and how to split it, instead of silently changing all of it and reporting success.
